## About this fork: Mogan STEM with extra patches (rolling)

This is [MoganLab/mogan](https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan) plus the patches listed below. Clone it and build it as described in the upstream documentation; nothing else differs.

- **Base:** upstream `8161b11d4` (2026-10-21): [200_22] bump to Mogan STEM v2026.3.8-rc.3
- **Patches on top:** 9 (`main` is 30 commits ahead of the base, including merge commits)
- **Branches:** `main` = base + patches, append-only (safe to `git pull`, never force-pushed); `upstream-main` = untouched mirror of upstream; `pr/<name>` = one patch each, as submitted upstream.
- **Updated:** 2026-10-21

| Patch | Upstream status | Branch |
|---|---|---|
| **Fix Enter in aligned nesting the table instead of adding a row**<br>math-edit.scm has an old kbd-enter for aligned that treats its content as one formula: it splits it at the first relation into two columns and wraps it in a new table. | not submitted | [`pr/aligned-enter-nesting`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/aligned-enter-nesting) |
| **Support amsmath aligned and gathered: gathered macro, LaTeX import and export**<br>Add gathered, the centered one-column counterpart of aligned. | not submitted | [`pr/amsmath-aligned-gathered`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/amsmath-aligned-gathered) |
| **Delay the mode/focus toolbar refresh while the cursor moves**<br>Moving through nested math changes the focus path almost every step, and each change rebuilt the mode and focus icon bars synchronously in apply_changes (menu-expand, 40-60 ms in math on a large document), so every key press waited for it. | not submitted | [`pr/delay-toolbar-refresh`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/delay-toolbar-refresh) |
| **Import \left\&#124; as a double bar**<br>The label \&#124; lost its backslash in the \left/\right branch and became a single bar, unlike \Vert. | not submitted | [`pr/latex-left-double-bar`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/latex-left-double-bar) |
| **LaTeX: map matrix/pmatrix/bmatrix to native Mogan tags**<br>Export: Mogan's matrix (parenthesised) now exports as amsmath pmatrix and bmatrix as bmatrix, instead of \left(/\left[ around an array. | not submitted | [`pr/latex-matrix-envs`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/latex-matrix-envs) |
| **Nested norms: import bar{group}bar, export braces**<br>The importer reads \&#124;{...}\&#124; as a norm containing the group instead of pairing the nearest bars. | not submitted | [`pr/latex-nested-norms`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/latex-nested-norms) |
| **Skip the whole-document conversion in get_remote_cursors when there are none**<br>get_remote_cursors() runs on every repaint (draw_remote_cursors in draw_post) and converted the whole buffer with tree_to_linear_ir before looking at remote_cursors. | not submitted | [`pr/skip-remote-cursors-on-repaint`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/skip-remote-cursors-on-repaint) |
| **Make the style cache notice changed style and package files**<br>The compiled-style cache is keyed only by the style name, so a package change (a new macro in env-math.stem) never invalidated an entry written before. | not submitted | [`pr/style-cache-invalidation`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/style-cache-invalidation) |
| **Add user keyboard layer: user-kbd-map / user-kbd-unmap**<br>Built-in keyboard modules are loaded lazily (and since [1143] after the user init file), and bindings resolve most-recent-first, so a later built-in registration silently replaced user bindings. | not submitted | [`pr/user-keyboard-layer`](https://github.com/guraltsev/mogan/tree/pr/user-keyboard-layer) |

# Mogan STEM

Mogan STEM is a professional scientific writing platform targeted at mathematics, physics, statistics, and computer science, specially designed to handle complex formula-based documents. It is deeply optimized from [GNU TeXmacs](https://www.texmacs.org/), with emphasis on performance and user experience. With Mogan STEM you can create scientific documents up to 100x faster than with $\LaTeX$.

**Visit the official websites:**
- **Mogan STEM (Community Version)**: [https://mogan.app](https://mogan.app)
- **Liii STEM (Commercial Version, Free with built-in AI and OCRs)**: [https://liiistem.com](https://liiistem.com/?utm_source=moganwebsite&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=moganwebsite)

## Key Features

### 📋 Magic Paste
- Supports mainstream AI models such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini
- Automatically recognizes mathematical formulas, code blocks, tables, and other complex formats
- One-click conversion to the standard TeXmacs format with no manual adjustment required
- Preserves original formatting and style integrity

![Magic Paste PRE](./public/images/magic-paste_en.gif)

### 🛠 Export PDF & LaTeX
- Batch export in multiple formats to suit different scenarios
- PDF export: preserves original document layout and supports high-resolution printing
- LaTeX export: improves compilation success rate and is compatible with mainstream journal submission requirements

![Export PRE](./public/images/pdf.gif)
![Export PRE](./public/images/LaTex.gif)

### ⚡ Fast Math Editing
- Independent math mode: quick switching and focused formula editing
- Smart shortcuts: Lego-like memory rules and Tab-key cycling to reduce mouse operations
- Rich symbol library: covers a complete set of mathematical and physical symbols with numerous key combinations

![Math Editing PRE](./public/images/eq.gif)

### 🎓 Easy to learn, capable of thesis-level editing
- Three primary modes switch seamlessly; easy to operate and quick to get started
- Clear structure for different content types and well-organized document hierarchy
- Click to insert environments; complex typesetting becomes simple

![Thesis-level Edits PRE](./public/images/Thesis-level-Edits.png)

### Scientific Document Creation
- High-quality typesetting: professional document formatting with TeX quality output
- Mathematical notation: advanced formula editing with LaTeX compatibility
- Bibliography management: built-in reference and citation tools

### Performance & Usability
- Faster startup: optimized performance compared to TeXmacs
- Responsive interface: modern Qt6-based user interface
- Cross-platform: available for Windows, macOS, and Linux

### Integration with other scientific tools
- Plugin system: extensible via multiple programming languages (Python, C++, Scheme) and tools
- Document formats: supports TeXmacs, LaTeX, PDF, HTML, and more
- Interactive plotting: integration with data analysis tools for interactive plots

## Quick Start

### Installation

#### Option 1: Mogan STEM (Community Version)
From Release: Download the latest release for your platform from [GitHub releases](https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan/releases).

#### Option 2: Build from Source

Clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/MoganLab/mogan.git
cd mogan
```

For detailed setup, dependency installation, build, and run instructions, please follow the guide for your platform:

- [GNU/Linux Development Guide](devel/Develop_on_Linux.md)
- [Windows Development Guide](devel/Develop_on_Windows.md)
- [macOS Development Guide](devel/Develop_on_macOS.md)

#### Option 3: Liii STEM (Commercial Version)
For the commercial version with built-in AI features, please visit the [Liii STEM official website](https://liiistem.com?utm_source=moganwebsite&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=moganwebsite) for installation options.
